title: Visual Inspection: Multimodal UI Audit Against Design Spec
description: Capture screenshots of the rendered dashboard at multiple breakpoints (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1440px) and perform a multimodal visual inspection against the Frontend Craft Triad specifications. Verify dark mode contrast, typographic hierarchy, touch target sizing, layout stress-testing, and absence of AI-slop patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots captured at 375px, 768px, and 1440px widths for: dashboard home, artist leaderboard, artist detail, track gainers
VERIFY: No AI-slop patterns detected (centered hero, 3-col cards, gradient blobs, generic borders)
VERIFY: Dark mode contrast ratio meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text)
VERIFY: Stream numbers and delta badges are visually prominent — leading the hierarchy
VERIFY: Touch targets are minimum 44x44px on mobile views
VERIFY: No text overflow or clipping on extreme content lengths
VERIFY: Responsive layout adapts cleanly across breakpoints without horizontal scroll
VERIFY: Amber/industrial accent colors are consistent across views
Output a detailed audit report to .agent-state/tasks/T-104-report.md with PASS/FAIL per criterion and annotated screenshots
